favourite.heading: Why Ohio State can pull away
bullets: Ohio State is the better football team by 29.6 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+29.6 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 9.7 points to Ohio State (+9.7 pts).
Stylistically the matchup favours Ohio State by 5.4 points: ball control vs front disruption (+5.4 pts).
Playing at Ohio State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Kent State can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 +25.7 to p90 +69.7 for Ohio State, so a projection of +48.7 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.

The market disagrees by 3.8 points. The market is not the truth, but a gap that large is more often the model missing information (a suspension, a starter, a scheme change) than the market being wrong.
